body: Implemented: hits route by type (ticket → detail URL, comment → owning ticket with the comment page loaded via ?around and focused, document → reader; missing targets show a message). Rows show type icon, key, title, status lozenge, parent ('in PM-1 Header'), an original-text snippet around the match with escaped highlighting, and 'similar meaning' for semantic-only hits. Internal file paths are no longer sent to the UI. Queries are trimmed, debounced, request-generation guarded and show a 'Searching …' state with aria-busy.
author: local
